business_problem: Capita wanted to remove manual administrative burdens, accelerate decision making, and improve auditability and consistency in internal workflows such as training bookings and fire risk assessment review.
solution_summary: Capita’s AI transformation here is an internally adopted operating model rather than a single packaged application. The company uses Multiverse as the external enablement platform to train employees at scale, then turns that training into applied AI projects inside day-to-day operations. Learners on the AI for Business Value, Level 4 programme identify manual bottlenecks, build targeted AI automations, and embed them in business workflows. In the example cited, Training Operations Manager Dave Collingwood created an AI-enabled booking workflow that takes inputs from the training team’s booking process and writes them into a more auditable, data-rich system, sharply reducing cycle time. Capita is extending the same pattern in Capita Fire and Rescue, where an internal AI agent reviews completed fire risk assessments to provide assurance at scale and reduce inconsistency in a safety-critical process.

solution_components.name: Multiverse
solution_components.role: Provided the upskilling platform and programmes Capita used to train employees and scale applied AI projects across the business.

solution_components.name: AI for Business Value, Level 4
solution_components.role: Taught Capita staff to identify and execute high-impact AI use cases tied to operational problems.

solution_components.name: AI agent
solution_components.role: An internally developed agent for Capita Fire and Rescue that is being built to provide assurance on completed fire risk assessments.

data_flow: Workflow data from teams such as training operations enters AI-enabled automations built by Capita employees after Multiverse-led training. The automation processes booking inputs and writes outputs into a more auditable, data-rich system used by the team. In Capita Fire and Rescue, completed fire risk assessments are fed to an internal AI agent, which returns assurance results for operational users reviewing the 6,000 assessments completed each year.
business_outcome: Capita reports workforce-wide time savings, lower cost-of-service, faster booking operations, better auditability, and improved assurance for safety-critical assessments.

architecture_clues: Capita scaled AI upskilling from more than 500 employees to a further 250 staff members.
The initial cohort delivered over 400 applied AI projects and identified 40 unique AI use cases.
One internal use case created a more auditable, data-rich booking system.
A safety-related assurance use case targets 6,000 fire risk assessments completed annually.
